subject: MediCore HIPAA: LLM data-flow attestation and retention questions
messages:
From: Dr. Amy Chen <amy.chen@medicore.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: compliance@medicore.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: LLM training & retention — request for HIPAA attestation and evidence

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking this. MediCore is evaluating Redwood for a pilot that will include PHI in prompts (de-identified clinical summaries + some free-text clinician notes). Our security and privacy team need a succinct attestation and supporting artifacts to show to InfoSec and the legal team. Specifically we need answers to:  

- Do you use customer-provided input (prompts/responses) to further train or fine-tune models by default? If not by default, what explicit opt-in flows exist?
- For hosted API customers, what is the default retention period for prompt and response logs? Is there a separate billing/monitoring telemetry retention?
- How do you isolate PHI in logs and K/V cache? Is there guaranteed redaction/pseudonymization available before storage?
- For customers that require HIPAA BAA, which deployment modes are supported (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)?
- Can you provide SOC 2 artifacts or a SOC 2 summary and a network/data-flow diagram for our DPIA?

We attached our questionnaire (MediCore-Questionnaire.xlsx) and would appreciate a short attestation PDF and links to the SOC2 summary and any data-flow diagrams. Is it possible to return a preliminary response by EOD Tue next week (Jan 20)?

Thanks,
Amy
Dr. Amy Chen
Director, Privacy & Compliance
MediCore Health

[Attachment: MediCore-Questionnaire.xlsx]

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Amy Chen <amy.chen@medicore.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: LLM training & retention — request for HIPAA attestation and evidence

Hi Amy — thanks for the clear list. Below is an operational summary we can use for your DPIA. I'm copying Laura (Privacy/Legal) and Marissa (CS lead) to assemble the evidence kit.

Short answers (summary):
- Training on customer data: Redwood does NOT use customer prompts/responses to update or train public model weights by default. Data is only used for model training if a customer explicitly opts in via a documented consent/contracting flow. We can provide an attestation to this effect.
- Retention (hosted API): default storage for prompts/responses and operational logs is 30 days for billing/abuse detection/quality monitoring. For Dedicated and Private deployments, retention is configurable and can be set to 0 days (no persistent logging) or to customer-specified retention windows.
- PHI handling & pseudonymization: for hosted we offer an optional pre-storage redaction pipeline (customer-managed or Redwood-managed) that can pseudonymize obvious PHI patterns (names, MRNs, SSNs). Additionally, KV caches are encrypted in transit and at rest; scoped cache eviction policies are available for Dedicated customers.
- BAAs: Redwood offers HIPAA BAA for Private and Dedicated deployment packages (common for healthcare customers). For Hosted (public API) we review on a case-by-case basis for enterprise customers; please let us know if you require a Hosted BAA and we will escalate.
- Evidence: attaching a SOC2 summary (redacted) and a high-level data-flow diagram (HIPAA_DataFlow_diagram_v1.pdf). We will upload a focused evidence folder to a shared Drive link for your review.

Operational detail (one-paragraph answers you can include in the DPIA):
Redwood's hosted inference service separates control plane metadata from customer request payloads. Request payloads are encrypted client->edge and decrypted only on the serving host; tokens and KV cache are stored encrypted using customer-scoped keys for Dedicated/Private or Redwood-managed keys for hosted. By default, logs containing request/response text are retained for 30 days solely for billing reconciliation, abuse detection, and SLO/quality monitoring; logs are not used to train or improve model weights without explicit customer opt-in. Customers can opt for additional redaction (regex/pattern) and pseudonymization prior to storage; Dedicated/Private customers can configure retention to meet statutory needs and bring their own KMS.

Next steps: Laura/Marissa — can you prepare a 1-page attestation and gather the SOC2 excerpt + the network/data-flow export for the Drive folder? Amy, we'll target delivering the attestation and Drive link by end of day Jan 20 as requested.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0197

Attachments: HIPAA_DataFlow_diagram_v1.pdf, SOC2-report-abstract.pdf

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: LLM training & retention — request for HIPAA attestation and evidence

Mateo — thanks for drafting. A few legal notes / redlines before we send to MediCore: 

- Attestation language: include explicit sentence that "Redwood will not use customer data to train, improve, or fine-tune model weights absent a written opt-in agreement." Avoid any wording implying ephemeral internal experiments.
- Retention table: please include the exact retention windows available per deployment (Hosted default=30 days, Hosted enterprise exceptions available; Dedicated/Private configurable 0-3650 days).
- BAA scope: clarify that BAAs cover processing performed in Dedicated and Private; for Hosted we can provide contractual protections but Hosted BAAs require an enterprise procurement and security review.
- Evidence checklist: SOC2 summary (signed), network/data-flow diagram (current), encryption/KMS diagram, sample redaction config, export of retention config UI/screenshot. Prefer PDFs.

Marissa — can you assemble the Drive folder and drop the SOC2 PDF + screenshots of retention settings? Mateo — I'll prepare the one-page attestation (legal sign-off) and add a short bullet describing the opt-in flow for training.

I'll review the final package and we can send to Amy with the Drive link and a DocuSign option for the attestation if they want.

Laura Bennett
Head of Privacy & Legal, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
